changeSet.sql: WITH totals AS ( SELECT qs.id AS statistic_id, COALESCE(SUM(q.points), 0.0) AS overall_points FROM quiz_statistic qs JOIN exercise e ON e.quiz_point_statistic_id = qs.id LEFT JOIN quiz_question q ON q.exercise_id = e.id WHERE qs.discriminator = 'QP' GROUP BY qs.id ), normalized AS ( SELECT c.id AS source_id, c.quiz_point_statistic_id AS statistic_id, c.points AS source_points, CASE WHEN c.points IS NULL OR c.points::text IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') OR c.points < 0 OR c.points <> FLOOR(c.points) OR c.points > FLOOR(t.overall_points + 0.5) THEN 0.0 ELSE c.points END AS normalized_points, GREATEST(COALESCE(c.rated_counter, 0), 0)::bigint AS rated_counter, GREATEST(COALESCE(c.un_rated_counter, 0), 0)::bigint AS unrated_counter FROM quiz_statistic_counter c JOIN totals t ON t.statistic_id = c.quiz_point_statistic_id WHERE c.discriminator = 'PC' ), merged AS ( SELECT statistic_id, normalized_points, COALESCE(MIN(source_id) FILTER (WHERE source_points = normalized_points), MIN(source_id)) AS id, SUM(rated_counter) AS rated_counter, SUM(unrated_counter) AS unrated_counter FROM normalized GROUP BY statistic_id, normalized_points ), aggregated AS ( SELECT statistic_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', id, 'points', normalized_points, 'ratedCounter', rated_counter, 'unRatedCounter', unrated_counter ) ORDER BY normalized_points) AS counters FROM merged GROUP BY statistic_id ) UPDATE quiz_statistic qs SET counters = COALESCE(a.counters, '[]'::jsonb) FROM totals t LEFT JOIN aggregated a ON a.statistic_id = t.statistic_id WHERE qs.id = t.statistic_id;

changeSet.sql: WITH totals AS ( SELECT qs.id AS statistic_id, COALESCE(SUM(q.points), 0.0) AS overall_points FROM quiz_statistic qs JOIN exercise e ON e.quiz_point_statistic_id = qs.id LEFT JOIN quiz_question q ON q.exercise_id = e.id WHERE qs.discriminator = 'QP' GROUP BY qs.id ), normalized AS ( SELECT c.id AS source_id, c.quiz_point_statistic_id AS statistic_id, c.points AS source_points, CASE WHEN c.points IS NULL OR c.points < 0 OR c.points <> FLOOR(c.points) OR c.points > FLOOR(t.overall_points + 0.5) THEN 0.0 ELSE c.points END AS normalized_points, CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(c.rated_counter, 0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS rated_counter, CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(c.un_rated_counter, 0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS unrated_counter FROM quiz_statistic_counter c JOIN totals t ON t.statistic_id = c.quiz_point_statistic_id WHERE c.discriminator = 'PC' ), merged AS ( SELECT statistic_id, normalized_points, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN source_points = normalized_points THEN source_id END), MIN(source_id)) AS id, SUM(rated_counter) AS rated_counter, SUM(unrated_counter) AS unrated_counter FROM normalized GROUP BY statistic_id, normalized_points ), ordered AS ( SELECT statistic_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'id', id, 'points', normalized_points, 'ratedCounter', rated_counter, 'unRatedCounter', unrated_counter )) OVER ( PARTITION BY statistic_id ORDER BY normalized_points ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ) AS counters, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY statistic_id ORDER BY normalized_points DESC) AS aggregate_row_number FROM merged ) UPDATE quiz_statistic qs LEFT JOIN ordered o ON o.statistic_id = qs.id AND o.aggregate_row_number = 1 SET qs.counters = COALESCE(o.counters, JSON_ARRAY()) WHERE qs.discriminator = 'QP';
